label: A10 defeasible causal expectation versus actual support and modal possibility
term: A10 defeasible causal expectation versus actual support and modal possibility
resolution: A10 asks for a reported causal default, not no-uncaused-contingents, a universal PSR or modal causal opportunity. Prima-facie evidence for a cause is not the cause, an actual concrete contributor or Dia of that cause; more-likely-than-not has no supplied probability semantics. Selecting a first contingent is not random sampling and needs a reference-class/applicability and defeater bridge. Cause is a prior partial explanatory condition, not automatically a complete necessitating ground, temporal existence, Ontic.Causes or ontological support. Complete means closure against outside member-causes; infinite means no first member, not infinite cardinality. Cause-or-effect concrete capability is broader than actual exercise or cause-only capability. First-contingent externality needs the same history/population and prior-bearer/absence guards. The de-dicto modal suffix consumes possibility; it does not transport default warrant, exchange Box-exists with exists-Box or identify a rigid necessary individual. Source/report-to-truth, classification, domain, history and epistemic correspondences remain OPEN. No new formal semantics is selected for the default. C’s nominal Necessary Being requires cause-capability, while its coverage/concrete title includes cause-OR-effect capability. Thus dropping necessarily-all-concreta-contingent can leave a noncontingent effect-only candidate: matching P2/C domains does not close this source-Necessary-Being capability bridge. Bare necessary-concrete consequences remain distinct and may apply under their own explicit modal/correspondence premises. Alternate contexts: A10P3B asks the narrow possible-impossibility input, but C2 literally recalls original invariance; A2’s bundled contraposition/duality explanation is not attributed here. P3C specifically reaffirms a defeasible default under revised classification, not exceptionless causation or generic keep/revisit. C3 literally concludes actual existence after a merely prima-facie possible-cause prefix, then adds an epistemic qualification; preserving both does not validate the warrant-to-Dia transition. No all-entry-route/session assent or uniform modal substitution is inferred. C3’s same final paragraph explicitly ends with the alternative that one has a prima-facie reason to think so. Thus the whole conclusion remains epistemically qualified: literal actuality wording and its parenthetical are both retained, with no attribution of unqualified certainty or demonstrated prima-facie-to-truth fallacy. A2 revised-actuality reuse is only the conditional revised-classification possibility-to-actuality pattern; no independent actual possibility premise is supplied. Default applicability and epistemic transfer remain OPEN, not refuted. Approved causal no-first sibling is separately defined; it is neither a conjunctive mapping nor replacement of original composite sense _3. Original applicability and coverage remain OPEN.
